'''Loya''' is a servant in the [[Tarasin Palace]] in [[Ebou Dar]], [[Altara]]. She is slender with bee-stung lips.
==Activities==
She helps [[Olver]] move into his new rooms. When he makes a comment about her, she starts tickling him.
